# StreamDek Mobile v2.1.18

*Version code 76*

## What's New

**Live channels from CloudStream plugins**
Channels from CloudStream plugins now behave like every other live channel in StreamDek. Their
Home rows sit with your other live rows, above Streaming Networks, and use the landscape channel
cards when **Settings → Live TV → Landscape channel cards** is on. Their **View all** pages open as
channel lists. Opening a channel shows a live channel page rather than a film's, playing it uses
the live player, and you can add it to your Favourites from the channel page, the player, a
channel list or a Home card. StreamDek recognises a plugin's channels even when the plugin labels
them as films, as long as the plugin says it is a live TV plugin.

**Plugin sub-sources you can actually turn on**
Some plugins, such as PlayZTV, SKTech and Sportzx, hold a whole set of channel groups — JioTV,
Sony, Zee, Pluto TV, Tubi and many more — that only appear once they are switched on in the
plugin's own settings. Those settings could not open in StreamDek until now. The settings button
beside a plugin now opens them as a StreamDek popup, with each option as a switch, listed A to Z
and searchable when there are many. Close the popup and your choices are saved and applied
straight away: the new groups appear under **Settings → Home Screen** within a few seconds, with no
need to restart the app.

**Live TV that finds a working source**
Many channels come with several sources, and some of them do not work. StreamDek now works through
them for you. If a source has not started showing a picture after 10 seconds, or fails outright,
the player moves on to the next one, trying each source once. While it does, the loading screen
tells you what is happening — **Connecting to source 1 of 4…**, then **Source didn't start. Trying
source 2 of 4…** — so a switch reads as the player working through its options, not as a stall.
The source that works is remembered, and next time that channel starts with it. This also works
when you switch channels from your Favourites in the player, including between channels from an
add-on and channels from a plugin.

**A new Live TV channel list header**
The **View all** page for a live row now matches Search. At the top you see the channel list's
title with a new grid button beside it, then the search box and the channel filters. Scroll down
and the title folds away: the search box stays pinned with the grid button beside it, the filters
pin in their own row underneath, and the search box shows how many channels it is searching —
**Search 650 Channels**. The grid button switches between the channel list and a grid of channel
cards; in the grid, press and hold a card to add it to your Favourites.

**Where your channels come from**
**Settings → Live TV → Where Channels Come From** now lists **Add-ons** and **Plugins** alongside
Playlists whenever they bring you live channels, and says how many — for example **2 sources from
CNC Repo with live channels**. Tap Add-ons, Plugins or Playlists and StreamDek opens that page
already scrolled to the ones that bring channels, with a brief shimmer across each so you can spot
them at a glance. The navigation bar tucks itself away while it does, so nothing is hidden behind
it.

**Headers that keep your filters**
On Search, your Watchlist, Continue Watching and streaming network pages, a section's heading and
its filters now fold into a single rounded row that stays pinned under the header as you scroll,
so you can change a filter from anywhere in the list. Where a page has a grid button, it comes down
beside the search box as the header condenses. On a **View all** list the search box names the list
it is searching — **Search Trending list** — with the number of titles at its end. Every View all
list now offers search, including Trending On Trakt and Recommended For You.

## Improvements

- **Live channels open on About.** A live channel's page now opens on its **About** tab, with any
  description its source provides — available servers, what is showing — rather than jumping
  straight to the source list. Play is still at the top, and Streams is one tap away.
- **Continue Watching is for things you can continue.** Live channels no longer appear in Continue
  Watching, on Home or on the Continue tab, including channels saved there by an earlier version.
- **Smoother scrolling on high refresh rate screens.** While you browse, StreamDek now asks for your
  screen's fastest refresh rate, up to 120Hz. Video playback keeps the rate the video needs.
- **The Default header style gets glass.** With the Default header style, the condensed search pill,
  the grid button and the pinned filter row now use frosted glass — dark in a dark theme, light in a
  light one — and the navigation bar matches it in dark mode.
- **A calmer title page.** Outlines are gone from the tabs, action buttons, trailer button, fact
  cards, **Available on** pills, Trakt comment cards and **Mark season as watched**. A soft shade
  keeps them apart from the page instead.
- **Plugin lists are tidier.** The test button beside each CloudStream source has been removed.
- **More helpful when a plugin row is empty.** When a plugin's Home row cannot load, StreamDek now
  records the actual reason, which makes a problem on the plugin's side much easier to track down.

## Fixed

- Fixed a plugin's settings opening an empty page.
- Fixed a plugin's channel groups never appearing in **Settings → Home Screen**, because they could
  only be switched on from settings that would not open.
- Fixed having to restart the app after changing a plugin's settings.
- Fixed a live channel that opens but never plays leaving a black player that never moved on to
  another source.
- Fixed switching to a plugin channel from your Favourites in the player getting stuck on
  **Switching channel**.
- Fixed a channel always starting with its first source, even when a different one worked last
  time.
- Fixed channels from plugins being impossible to add to your Favourites.
- Fixed plugin channels opening as a film page with **Continue from 00:00** and a resume position.
- Fixed a plugin's channel row, such as Music, being placed at the bottom of Home instead of with
  your other live rows.
- Fixed plugin live rows not using the landscape channel cards setting.
- Fixed **Where Channels Come From** counting each plugin source as a separate plugin.
- Fixed one search filling all three recent search slots as you typed; a search is now saved once it
  has settled with results.
- Fixed the tint behind filter selection dialogs stopping short of the status bar.
- Fixed a square ripple when tapping a profile on the profile picker; the tile now presses in.
- Fixed **View all** on the Home Watchlist row not opening your Watchlist.
